description: The attention back of a DeepSeek-V4.1 layer and its FFN boundary on one rank, as one launch (the K2 of sglang's AMD monokernel up to the MoE's input; under data-parallel attention the MoE's rows are gathered from the other ranks first). deepseekv41_sparse_mla's attention with the rotation back, rounded to bf16; each group of 8 heads times its rows of wo_a, rounded to bf16; that, to fp8 e4m3 at an e8m0 scale per 32 values, times wo_b, rounded to bf16: x, the attention's output on a rank holding every head. A rank of a TP group holds its share of the heads, of wo_a's groups and of wo_b's columns: x is then its wo_b output plus peer_x, the sum of the other ranks', which the caller's collective brings, rounded to bf16. Then the mHC boundary into the FFN and its RMSNorm, ffn_input: residual_out[j] = x * post_mix[j] + sum_i comb_mix[i, j] * residual[i], rounded to bf16; the layer input is sum_j mix[j] * residual_out[j] under the previous boundary's pre mix, rounded to bf16, then times rsqrt(mean square + norm_eps) and norm_weight. This boundary's mixes come of the 24 logits hc_fn @ flatten(residual_out) * rsqrt(mean square + hc_rms_eps): sigmoid(logits[:4] * hc_scale[0] + hc_base[:4]) + hc_eps the pre mix, twice the sigmoid of the next 4 at hc_scale[1] the post mix, and the last 16 at hc_scale[2] as a 4 x 4 softmax over its rows plus hc_eps, normalized over columns, then sinkhorn_iters - 1 times over rows and columns (each sum plus hc_eps), the combination mix. An fp8 wo_a comes with wo_a_scale, an e8m0 scale per 32 x 32 block, no block over two groups: the attended values are then rounded to fp8 e4m3 at an e8m0 scale per 32 values before it.

n_tokens.description: Tokens in this call, one query each.

page_size.description: Slots per page of the KV pool.

n_indices.description: Indices per token into the KV pool.

n_extra_pages.description: Pages of the extra KV pool.

extra_page_size.description: Slots per page of the extra KV pool.

n_extra_indices.description: Indices per token into the extra KV pool.

mix_dim.description: The four streams flattened: the mix projection's reduction.

hidden_blocks.description: MXFP8 blocks of a hidden row.

o_dim.description: wo_a's rows, a group's after another's: wo_b's reduction.

q.description: Each token's query per head, the RoPE part last.

kv_cache.description: The layer's KV pool: DeepSeek-V4's packed fp8 slots.

indices.description: Slots of the KV pool each token reads; negative: skipped.

sinks.description: Per-head logit added to the normalisation only.

extra_kv_cache.description: The extra KV pool, the same packed slots.

extra_indices.description: Slots of the extra KV pool each token reads; negative: skipped.

rope_freqs.description: The RoPE table: a (c, s) per pair of each position.

positions.description: Each token's row of the RoPE table.

wo_a.description: wo_a's weight over a group's 8 heads.

wo_a_scale.description: Per 32 x 32 block of an fp8 wo_a.

peer_x.description: The other ranks' wo_b outputs of these tokens, each in bf16, summed.

post_mix.description: The attention boundary's post mix, of x into each stream.

comb_mix.description: The attention boundary's combination mix: [token, from, to].

pre_mix.description: The attention boundary's pre mix, which the FFN's input sums the streams under.

hc_fn.description: Projects the flattened streams to the 24 mix logits: 4 pre, 4 post, 16 combination.

hc_scale.description: Scale of the pre, post and combination logits.

norm_weight.description: Weight of the RMSNorm of the mixed streams.

hc_rms_eps.description: Added to the mean square of the streams.

hc_eps.description: Added to each pre mix and in each Sinkhorn normalization.

norm_eps.description: Added to each RMSNorm's mean square.

sinkhorn_iters.description: Sinkhorn normalizations of the combination mix.

ffn_input.description: The MoE's input: the mixed streams under the post-attention RMSNorm.

residual_out.description: The streams after the owed post; the streams as given when none is owed.

pre_mix_out.description: This boundary's pre mix, which the next boundary sums the streams under.

post_mix_out.description: This boundary's post mix, of the post it owes.

comb_mix_out.description: This boundary's combination mix, of the post it owes.
